_comment: ADR-0027 Phase 2 governed manifest for the build-5833 broker-login validation image. Drift against this manifest fails closed (validation_image.verify_image / verify_source_hashes). Non-secret.

generated_structural_rules.run_in_layer: MQL5 standard library + compiled *.ex5, generated from the isolated image itself (NEVER copied from a production account environment)

expected_markers: launched with /portable (portable data lives beneath the image root, not %APPDATA%)

structural_fingerprint.definition: sha256 over sorted (relative-path|size) of all files EXCLUDING logs/*.log (validation_image.structural_fingerprint)

validation_root_rules: the image terminal dir must be BENEATH the configured validation root and disjoint from every forbidden root (validate_login.assert_isolated_validation_terminal)
cleanup_procedure: terminate only path-verified terminal64.exe under the image; remove logs + any accounts.dat; the runner scrubs + (optionally) restores a precompiled baseline after each probe
restore_procedure: re-run build_validation_image.ps1 (fresh isolated image); or mirror a certified precompiled baseline into the terminal dir
